_comment: Models offered by the admin console's AI Model section. Served statically like music_moods.json so the browser carries no hardcoded list to drift. Provider ids MUST be the ones server/services/llm/registry.js exposes: this file previously offered 'claude', which the registry does not know, so choosing it stored a provider nothing could resolve and every turn afterwards failed. A provider whose adapter can list its own models (anthropic, google, ollama) is better asked at runtime through the ai:models socket event; this list is the fallback for one that cannot be, and for showing something before a key exists.
